name: query_cbioportal
description: Query cBioPortal for cancer genomics data including somatic mutations, copy number, and expression across TCGA studies
usage: from app.tools.biomni.database_connectors import query_cbioportal; result = query_cbioportal('TP53', study_id='tcga_pan_can_atlas_2018')
returns: dict with keys: gene, study_id, mutations (list), copy_number, expression_percentile, alteration_frequency, source
